raw_text:
This document guides AI agents on go-mapi. Prerequisites: Read [README.md](README.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

Stack: C++ (MinGW), Go, TypeScript + React. Build: `npm run build` (or individual `npm run build:interceptor|native-host|extension`). Test: `npm run test`.

Privacy-focused/local-first: data stays local; external API calls only when necessary (Gmail API for sending). Cost-conscious; prefer solutions that don't require paid services. TypeScript strict mode required. Keep related things together; avoid excessive file splitting and bloat. Use React Bootstrap, Radix UI, or similar. Avoid utility-first CSS: No Tailwind. Prefer semantic markup. Prepare translations using message catalogs or i18n libraries. Technical documentation remains in English.

Interceptor (`src/interceptor/`): Capture MAPI calls and write JSON files to `%TEMP%\go-mapi\`. Zero external dependencies (no nlohmann/json - hand-rolled JSON). Target Simple MAPI spec only (not Extended MAPI/COM). Non-blocking - return immediately to caller. Thread-safe - multiple apps may call simultaneously. Always test with debug build: `npm run build:interceptor:debug`. Test with multiple calling applications. Check for memory leaks and thread safety.
